segments.sn19.10:1.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ kumbhaṇḍaṃ purisaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ.
segments.sn19.10:1.2: So gacchantopi teva aṇḍe khandhe āropetvā gacchati.
segments.sn19.10:1.4: Tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti.
segments.sn19.10:1.6: eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃyeva rājagahe gāmakūṭako ahosi…pe….
segments.sn19.10:2.5: Yo ca sibbiyati sūcako hi so,

lines: Tassa kammasabhāgatāya kumbhamattā mahāghaṭappamāṇā aṇḍā ahesuṃ.
So hi yasmā raho paṭicchanne ṭhāne lañjaṃ gahetvā kūṭavinicchayena pākaṭaṃ dosaṃ karonto sāmike assāmike akāsi, tasmāssa rahassaṃ aṅgaṃ pākaṭaṃ nibbattaṃ.
Yasmā daṇḍaṃ paṭṭhapento paresaṃ asayhaṃ bhāraṃ āropesi, tasmāssa rahassaṃ aṅgaṃ asayhabhāro hutvā nibbattaṃ.
Yasmā yasmiṃ ṭhāne ṭhitena samena bhavitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ ṭhatvā visamo ahosi, tasmāssa rahassaṅge visamā nisajjāva ahosīti.
So hi gāmajanakāyaṃ kūṭeti vañcetīti gāmakūṭakoti vuccati.
